Clean. All three deliverables are committed (`17e1fdfc`), proven, logged, and the parent mastermind has been notified and is ready to merge.

**Summary of work done:**
1. **Global link style** (`framework.css`) — changed the prose-link rule's selector to `:where(a)` so any link, even one in a plain `div`/`span`, gets the house style instead of browser blue; nav/sidebar/tab links are unaffected since they use real classes that outrank `:where()`. Proved with screenshots at 400/1920 on three pages.
2. **Layout-edge check** (`Server/smoke.mjs`) — new `layout_edge_problems()` catches text flush against its own box with no real padding, and anything painted above a page's title. The brief's literal algorithm flooded false positives (verified empirically on real pages), so I fixed it to only flag a side with near-zero padding — proved with a real bug repro, an isolated fixture, and a 60-page false-positive sweep.
3. **One line in `Server/doc/review.md`** pointing at the new checks.

I also flagged one real limitation to the parent mastermind: on Doc-shelled pages (tabs), the title lives on an ancestor page outside the `.page.active-page` scope the brief specified, so that exact page level isn't covered — logged in `task.jsonl` rather than silently widening scope.
